g.text: Headline number: at tau = 0.35 the detector keeps 86.7% of the AI agent segments and 83.3% of the frameworks while false-positiving on 2.72% of 1,582 real attackers; raising the threshold to 0.50 cuts the false-positive rate to 0.19% but drops segment recall to 73.3%.
